# unifi_heat_map (Data Source)

The `unifi_heat_map` data source retrieves an existing heat map by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing heat map by name.
data "unifi_heat_map" "download" {
  name = "Ground floor — download"
}

output "heat_map_type" {
  value = data.unifi_heat_map.download.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the heat map to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A free-form description of the heat map.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `map_id` (String) The identifier of the `unifi_map` this heat map belongs to.
- `type` (String) The metric the heat map represents (`download` or `upload`).
